title: Orientation cards and storyboard: README diagrams + reference app screenshot pack
creator: Ava Morales
description: Produce a cohesive asset bundle for the template apps quickstart: orientation card designs (mobile & desktop), a linear storyboard for the README, and a curated set of reference app screenshots optimized for doc hero images and gallery tiles.
acceptance_criteria: Orientation cards include copy variations for first-run, returning user, and demo modes
README storyboard exported as 3 SVG diagrams (flow, callouts, keyboard shortcuts) and a single PNG summary
Reference screenshots: 8 images (4 desktop, 4 mobile) exported at 2x and cropped to 16:9 and 4:5 variants
Assets delivered to Drive with clear naming, size spec, and usage notes for engineering/docs
Design token updates (colors/spacing) documented and linked for dev implementation
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with PM and eng. Scope defined: postcards + README storyboard + screenshot pack.
2026-02-17: Exploratory comps delivered. Team selected a minimalist card layout with micro-illustration and 2 CTA states.
2026-02-20: UX microcopy review: shortened first-visit copy to reduce cognitive load; agreed on progressive reveal of features.
2026-02-24: Dev sync: agreed on asset naming, token mapping, and responsive breakpoints. Jonah to add component placeholders in docs repo.
2026-02-27: Visual QA and accessibility pass; adjusted color contrast for primary CTAs to meet AA standards.
2026-03-01: Submitted final exports to Drive and opened implementation PR. This ticket set to In Review.
decisions: Use single-line headline + 1-sentence body copy in orientation cards to keep hero images uncluttered
Provide both 'Try now' and 'View docs' CTA states; default to 'Try now' for self-serve flows
Export screenshots at 2x for web docs and 3x for mobile Playbook images; crop master art to 16:9 and 4:5 so editors can reuse
Illustrations: lightweight line-style to match existing template app aesthetic and minimize localization redraws
followups: ENG-49210: Add orientation card component to docs site and wire CTAs to quickstart flow
DES-84513: Localize microcopy for DE/FR/JP markets
PM-5871: Confirm rollout plan for next console release (console-2026.03)
QA-9042: Nightly visual regression for exported screenshots
